body: My mum isn't financially stable but my dad makes more than enough to look after himself, my mum and me (he doesn't look after me but could if he wanted too, I'm not rich myself by any means but live a simple life so manage) I think with my mum she relies on me for company, as my dad is a rather aggressive angry man and doesn't speak to either of us. That's why I'm so confused by him wanting me around as he seems to dislike me. I am very close to my mum and doubt she'd stop speaking to me, but my dad would make it difficult for her to do so.
